message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes based on facts. The person is a credit officer at a rural credit cooperative. He illegally issued loans and misappropriated funds. This likely constitutes "职务侵占" (occupational embezzlement) and "挪用资金" (misappropriation of funds). In examples, similar case: "职务侵占;挪用特定款物" etc. Here it's illegal loan issuance to related parties and misusing funds. Could be "非法发放贷款" (illegal loan issuance) which is a crime under Chinese law: "非法发放贷款罪" (illegal loan issuance). Also "挪用资金" (misappropriation of funds). The examples: For credit cooperative loan fraud, they used "职务侵占" for embezzlement by staff. Also "挪用资金" used for misusing funds for personal use. The facts: He issued loans to others using false names, not repaid. That's illegal loan issuance and also misappropriation. The prosecution says "已构成××、××". Likely "非法发放贷款罪" and "挪用资金罪". In Chinese criminal law, "非法发放贷款罪" (Article 176) and "挪用资金罪" (Article 382?). So answer: [罪名]非法发放贷款;挪用资金<eoa>
